versions.short: The bill would amend the federal tax code so that a religious belief or practice about marriage, sexuality, or gender identity cannot be treated as inconsistent with law or public policy when the IRS decides whether a religious organization qualifies for tax-exempt status. It would also say that a belief still counts as religious even if it is not required by, or central to, a system of religion. The change would apply to tax years beginning after December 31, 2025.
